title: Felix Fox & The Glowing Tablet: Nature Is Fun!

lines.text: Felix the fox was glued to his shiny video game tablet from sunrise to sunset!
lines.caps: Felix the fox was glued to his shiny video game *TABLET | from sunrise to *SUNSET!

lines.text: Tap, swipe, click! His eyes were red, his neck was stiff, and his paws were crampy!
lines.caps: Tap, swipe, *CLICK! | His eyes were red, his neck was stiff, and his paws were *CRAMPY!

lines.text: Come chase autumn leaves and climb the mossy rocks! called his woodland friends!
lines.caps: Come chase autumn leaves and climb the mossy *ROCKS! | called his woodland *FRIENDS!

lines.text: Just five more minutes! mumbled Felix, staring at colorful digital pixels on the glass.
lines.caps: Just five more minutes! mumbled *FELIX, | staring at colorful digital pixels on the *GLASS!

lines.text: Mama Fox announced screen time is over, placed the tablet in the basket, and led him outside!
lines.caps: Mama Fox announced screen time is over, placed the tablet in the *BASKET, | and led him *OUTSIDE!

lines.text: The fresh pine breeze woke his senses, and the squishy grass tickled his furry paws!
lines.caps: The fresh pine breeze woke his *SENSES, | and the squishy grass tickled his furry *PAWS!

lines.text: They built a giant leaf fort, caught dandelion seeds, and raced up the sunny hill!
lines.caps: They built a giant leaf fort, caught dandelion *SEEDS, | and raced up the sunny *HILL!

lines.text: Screen time is fun in small doses, but real outdoor adventures make your body strong and happy!
lines.caps: Screen time is fun in small doses, but real outdoor adventures make your body *STRONG | and *HAPPY!

lines.text: Unplug and play outside—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
